newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond yields dip to new lows as prices soar.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond yields dip to new lows as prices soar.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Swiss bond yields continued to dip to lows unseen since the late 1970s. Demand centered on long maturities as the benchmark 10-year cash bond yield neared 3.50 percent.
* March Conf hits new record, ends up 61 at 120.43
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.532 pct vs 3.603 Monday.
